settings.question: How do I gift a Membership to a grandchild, niece or nephew?
settings.answer:
Buy a Membership and put the child's postal address in as the delivery address, so every mag arrives addressed to them. Your own address goes in as the billing address.

Add your message in the note box at the cart and we tuck it in with the first mag.

settings.question: Can I add a gift message?
settings.answer:
Yes. There is a short note box at the cart, and whatever you write goes in with the first mag.

Forgot? Email heyhey@theinmag.com.au with your order number before it posts and we will add it.

settings.question: Will they get the current issue or the next one first?
settings.answer:
You pick at the cart, from the covers on offer that day. A mag that is in print now posts within three business days. The next issue posts on drop day, in February, June or October. The price is the same either way.

If an issue has sold out in print we say so on its cover and skip it, and the child still gets every mag you paid for.

settings.question: Can you time the first mag to land before a birthday?
settings.answer:
Tell us the date in the order notes and we will do our best to have the first mag arrive just before it.

If the day is very close, give the Digital Stack. It is emailed within minutes, and you can print a favourite page to tuck into the card.

settings.question: I forgot to enter the child's address. Can it still go straight to them?
settings.answer: Yes. Email heyhey@theinmag.com.au with your order number and the child's address, and we will post it straight to them.

settings.question: What is the best last-minute gift option?
settings.answer: The Digital Stack. Every issue so far as PDFs, emailed to you within minutes of ordering, so you can forward it to the family or print a page for the card. Theirs to keep, nothing to renew.

settings.question: Can I buy from overseas, or send it overseas?
settings.answer:
Printed mags post anywhere in Australia, with shipping included on every Membership. If you are overseas and the child is in Australia, pop their Australian address in as the delivery address.

For now we do not post print overseas. Digital editions are opening to more countries soon.

settings.question: Is it right for a five year old? A twelve year old?
settings.answer:
theINmag is made for kids aged 5 to 13, and every page is by a real kid, so littlies, middles and oldies each find their bit: pictures and jokes for some, comics, stories and puzzles for others.

Grandparents tell us the whole family ends up reading it.

settings.question: Can the child send in their own creation?
settings.answer:
Yes, and it is free. Any Aussie kid can send IN a drawing, story, photo or joke at any time, and Members get first dibs on the next issue.

If it is published, their first name, town and age go in print. That tends to be the bit they remember.
